# Developer Portfolio & Blog - Project Instructions

## Project Overview
Full-stack portfolio and blog website with Next.js 14+, MongoDB, and dark minimalistic theme inspired by The Verge.

## Technology Stack
- Next.js 14+ (App Router)
- TypeScript
- MongoDB with Mongoose
- Tailwind CSS
- Dark minimalistic UI

## Features
- Portfolio sections (About, Projects, Skills)
- Blog with CRUD operations
- Responsive design
- SEO optimization
- Image optimization
